title: SPA/289/2017 of Doiwala Sugar Company Limited AND ANOTHER Vs Santraj Singh AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Stay Application No. 6371 of 2017
Urgency Application No. 135 of 2018
In
Special Appeal No. 289 of 2017
Doiwala Sugar Company Limited, Doiwala,
Dehradun and another ............ Appellants
Versus
Santraj Singh and others ............. Respondents
Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. Vinay Bhatt, Advocate for the
appellants.
Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate for respondent no. 1/writ petitioner.
Mr. J.C. Pande, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand/respondent no. 2.
Ms. Anjali Bhargava, Advocate for respondent no. 3.
Dated: 10th January, 2018
Coram: Hon'ble K.M. Joseph, C.J.
 Hon'ble U.C. Dhyani, J.
K.M. JOSEPH, C.J. (Oral)
 Appellants are respondent nos. 3 and 4 in the writ
petition. The writ petition filed by the writ
petitioner/respondent no. 1 has been allowed directing the
representation of the writ petitioner/respondent no. 1 to be
considered in view of Annexure No. 4. The judgment passed
by the learned Single Judge reads as follows:
"Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Vikas Pandey, Brief Holder for the State.
Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate assisted by
Mr. A.K. Arya, Advocate for the respondent nos.3
and 4.
Heard.
The attention of this Court has been drawn
towards the judgment dated 11.12.2002 rendered in
Civil Writ Petition No.235 (M/S) of 2001. This
judgment was reversed by the Hon'ble Supreme

2
Court in Civil Appeal No.6588 of 2003 on
12.05.2006.
However, despite that the General Manager
has recommended the case of the petitioner on
01.08.2008 vide Annexure No.4.
Petitioner has already made a representation
for redressal of his grievance before the Competent
Authority, till date the same has not been decided.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of
with the direction to the respondents to decide the
representation of the petitioner in view of Annexure
No.4 dated 01.08.2008 within a period of six weeks
from today.
Pending application, if any, also stands
disposed of."
2. We notice from the order sheet that actually the matter
was disposed of on the very first day it came up before the
learned Single Judge. There has been no opportunity to
exchange the pleadings.
3. We heard Mr. T.A. Khan, learned senior counsel
appearing on behalf of the appellants, Mr. C.K. Sharma, learned
counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no. 1/writ petitioner
and Ms. Anjali Bhargava, learned counsel appearing on behalf
of respondent no. 3.
4. We would think that the interest of justice would be sub-served if we set aside the judgment passed by the learned
Single Judge and remit the matter back so that the pleadings are
placed before the learned Single Judge and a decision is taken
thereafter.

3
5. Accordingly, the impugned judgment will stand set aside
and the case will stand listed before the learned Single Judge on
21.02.2018. By the said time, the appellants, as also, the other
respondents in the writ petition may file their counter
affidavit(s). Writ Petitioner/respondent no. 1 may also file
rejoinder affidavit if he is so advised. We request the learned
Single Judge to dispose of the matter at the earliest. We make it
clear that we have not expressed any view regarding the merits
of the matter.
 (U.C. Dhyani, J.) (K.M. Joseph, C. J.)
 10.01.2018 10.01.2018
Rahul
